description: This file defines an AuthProvider class managing user authentication states, including login, registration, logout, and profile updates, using an API client for server communication.

classes.name: AuthProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier class that manages authentication state and operations.

methods.name: AuthProvider
methods.description: Constructor initializing the AuthProvider with an API client.

methods.name: currentUser
methods.description: Getter returning the current authenticated user, if any.

methods.name: isLoading
methods.description: Getter indicating whether an auth operation is ongoing.

methods.name: isAuthenticated
methods.description: Getter indicating whether a user is currently authenticated.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Authenticate user with email and password, set user state.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Register a new user with provided details, then authenticate.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Clear authentication token and reset user state.
